wallLeftPx/wallRightPx of FRONT and REAR span the printed 16.82 m, i.e. from the outer face of the bay to the garage wall. The main-body left wall itself is at about x 124 on FRONT and x 576 on REAR (bay projection about 1.0 m); the garage/main junction is at about x 416 on FRONT and x 276 on REAR.
The angled bay windows are listed both on LEFT (L2, L4) and, foreshortened, on FRONT (F1) and REAR (B7): each is one physical window in a 45-degree wall.
The coupled roof windows on the garage roof (F11/F12, B9/B10) are two frames with a narrow bar between them; counted as two openings, one double unit is the other reading.
REAR B6 and LEFT L1 stand in walls set back under the roofed rear-left corner, not in the outermost wall plane; FRONT F5 and F6 stand in the set-back porch wall.
RIGHT: no opening is drawn on the garage gable or on the main gable above it; the dark arch at the left is the open side of the entrance porch.
On the side pictures the zero row is not marked; it was placed from the printed ridge level (+8,13) and the picture scale. The garage ridge (+6,49 printed) is at row 96 on FRONT/REAR and RIGHT.
LEFT: the bay reads x 333..440 on the picture, about 0.4 m wider than the plan's bay measured from the rear wall; wall ends were kept at the corner column (243) and the front wall (551).
